proposition.claim:
Strict endpoint predicate is false and auxiliary maximal-piece counting predicate counts arbitrary subsegments.

False converse from nonclassification to generic turbulence for an arbitrary given action.

Unexcluded singleton contradicts unrestricted corollary ranges.

Allowed length-two circular path gives ambiguous signed weight.

The local-tree seed does not imply the global Core=Star equality used to prove core connectedness.

Finite graph counter-calculation to strict joining-edge lower bound.
